pages.text: Use a wooden box side with a canopy to install it; sneak-use the side to remove it. Both forms are supported and dimensions adapt to the box. A cover cannot be fitted at the same time.$(br2)Use the front or rear curtains to toggle them independently. Sneaking is unnecessary.

The roof, sides and closed curtains have thin collision surfaces and block interactions through fabric. Open curtains for access to cargo. Stools and mats remain usable with sufficient clearance.$(br2)Interior ribs and decorative entrance rims do not block entities. The actual roof and sides still stop the wagon in passages that are too low or narrow.

pages.text: The top row uses matching wool, which determines the canopy and curtain colour.
